'''Republic Domestic Security''' ('''RDS''') was a domestic [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], formed by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The RDS reported directly to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] and was notably separate from the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. The agency was charged with handling all breaches in security by civil servants. At their [[Republic Domestic Security facility|headquarters]], the RDS conducted interrogations and held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] unless they were transferred to [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] for further questioning. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] [[Republic Treasury Audit Division|Audit Division]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jilka Zan Zentis]] was arrested by the RDS for illegally copying and removing data from Treasury [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. However, the information was planted, and Zentis was later freed by members of the [[Clan Skirata|Skirata Clan]].

So RDS won't share information with us any more freely than Intel does, so I'm planning to stroll over there and extract her if need be.|Sergeant Vau and Jedi General Zey|<ref name="Order66" />}}
Republic Domestic Security (RDS) was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] domestic [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] that operated toward the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The agency was commissioned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and separate from the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and the civilian police structure on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Instead, it reported directly to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] and was charged with ensuring the security of the Republic's closest secrets from any electronic breach by civil servants. To that end, they worked closely with [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]. The RDS also had their own [[Republic Domestic Security facility|prison facilities]].<ref name="Order66" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the RDS arrested [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] [[Republic Treasury Audit Division|Audit Division]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jilka Zan Zentis]] for illegally copying and removing data from Treasury [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. However, the evidence against Zentis had been planted to divert attention from Agent [[Besany Wennen]], who was gathering information for [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]]. Skirata and [[Clan Skirata|his clan]] had been tracking information on Palpatine's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] deployments and were securing funds to flee the Republic. When Wennen told them that Zentis had been arrested, they made plans to free her. Posing as a Republic Intelligence [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] arranged for Wennen to be transferred to Republic Intelligence custody. When the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] left the RDS facility, Sergeants [[Wad'e Tay'haai]] and [[Walon Vau]], along with Ordo, ambushed the transport midair, forcing it to land, and freed Zentis from the RDS agents.<ref name="Order66" /> With the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the duties of the RDS were given to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].<ref name="Dissolved" /><ref name="ImpCom">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Republic Domestic Security first appeared in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Order66" />
